slides.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE new finished Romanian Instagram carousel slide, portrait 4:5, matching the supplied image's elegant editorial visual system. Input image role: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target; replace its old copy with the exact new copy below. Preserve brand feeling: intimate, mature, thoughtful, blue/cream/amber, Cormorant Garamond-like medium and expressive italic serif headlines with upright Inter-like sans-serif supporting copy. Quiet fine film grain and broad diffuse organic shadows, crisp legible typography with accurate Romanian diacritics ș ț ă â î. Very spacious left-aligned composition, roughly 80px side margins at 1080px width. Large serif headline, 40px-ish supporting text; small tracked sans-serif top-left series label. The only recurring label is "UN SPAȚIU PENTRU TINE" at the top. No footer whatsoever: no horizontal footer separator, no name, no signature, no Instagram handle, no logo, no pagination, no bottom text. Keep the lowest 9 percent empty textured background for later manual branding. Main body must stay well above that empty zone. Sparse refined cream or ink line drawings of tangible room objects, slight asymmetry, open interiors. No people or invented photographs, no boxes, cards, badges, app interface, gradient text, stock wellness symbols, cosmic imagery, silk folds. This is one coherent sequence: invitation to the offered free first online therapy session, relatable topic, welcoming explanation of first conversation, and an exploratory webinar interest CTA. Do not invent dates, duration, guarantees or professional credentials. Render ONLY the top label and exact slide-specific copy.
Slide 1: invitation. Atmospheric muted rich blue #286787 with deep navy #092838 diffuse shadows. Cream #F7F1E5 text, pale-gold #E8D69C accent on "cu cineva?". Upper-middle headline in large elegant serif:
Ți-ar prinde bine
să vorbești
cu cineva?
Italicize only "cu cineva?".
Supporting copy beneath in upright clean sans-serif:
Prima ședință este gratuită.
Ne cunoaștem online, în ritmul tău.
One small low-positioned elegant empty-armchair and floor-lamp outline in cream, its baseline no lower than 85 percent down. Empty bottom background, NO FOOTER.
